items.title: Reallusion Unlocks Limitless Creation: iClone Personal Debuts Alongside AI Studio Official Launch
items.excerpt: Reallusion debuts iClone Personal (free for all users) alongside the official public launch of AI Studio, folding AI-assisted character animation into its pipeline, with an RTX render engine open beta following in late July.
items.why: A concrete tool-access shift: a professional character-animation pipeline goes free while its AI layer officially launches — lowers the barrier for indie animation/previs work.

items.title: Days of Future Shock: What to Expect at SIGGRAPH 2026
items.excerpt: A preview of SIGGRAPH 2026 (July 19-23, Los Angeles) as a snapshot of the new technologies — from generative AI to neural rendering — impacting the animation and VFX worlds this year.
items.why: Maps where film/animation AI craft is heading in the next two weeks; distinct angle from the already-published CAF winners card (conference tech program vs. festival awards).

items.title: 'M3GAN' Spinoff 'Soulm8te' Goes Straight to Digital After Theatrical Release Pulled, Trailer Unveils Killer Robot Girlfriend
items.excerpt: Universal's 'M3GAN' AI-robot spinoff 'Soulm8te' unveils its killer-robot-girlfriend trailer and moves to a straight-to-digital release (August 1) after being pulled from the theatrical calendar.
items.why: AI-on-screen story in the section's established lane (cf. Koreeda android trailer card); also a datapoint on how studios position AI-themed genre films.

items.title: Mexico's Alonso Ruizpalacios: AI, Trojan Horses and Coping With Loss
items.excerpt: At his BAM masterclass, director Alonso Ruizpalacios ('The Kitchen') discussed the perils of AI for film craft and argued for more 'Trojan horse' filmmaking inside the industry.
items.why: Auteur-perspective counterweight on AI and craft; weaker workflow hook — use only if the pool needs a discourse piece.

items.title: Harvey Keitel Shooting Film by Daphna Kastner, Denounces AI 'Danger'
items.excerpt: Harvey Keitel, shooting a new film written by Daphna Kastner, warns of the 'danger' in actors like Michael Caine licensing their voices to AI — the latest flashpoint in the performer-likeness debate.
items.why: Extends the voice-likeness thread (Hasbro child-voices card) with a marquee actor's refusal; discourse item, moderate priority.

items.title: Boris FX Acquires iZotope: RX, Ozone Join Lineup
items.excerpt: Boris FX acquires iZotope, bringing the AI-powered RX audio-repair and Ozone tools into the same stable as Sapphire and Mocha — consolidating a large chunk of the film post-production AI toolchain under one vendor.
items.why: Borderline business news, but with a real workflow hook: RX is the de facto AI dialogue-repair standard in film post, and ownership shapes its roadmap/licensing.

items.title: 'Weird Al' Yankovic Turned Down 'Nice Pile of Money' for AI Ad
items.excerpt: 'Weird Al' Yankovic says he turned down a 'nice pile of money' to appear in an AI-generated ad, a high-profile refusal in the growing debate over performers lending their likeness to generative AI.
items.why: Likeness-rights discourse from a beloved entertainer; tangential to film craft — lowest-priority filler, drop first if the final 5 is tight.

items.title: Easy AI VFX You Can Add to Any Video
items.excerpt: Matt Wolfe walks through practical AI VFX effects creators can drop into ordinary footage with current gen-AI tools. Upload date verified via watch-page JSON-LD (2026-07-08T13:28:53-07:00).
items.why: Hands-on AI VFX tutorial from the rotation-emphasized channel; note 'AI VFX' theme had a Corridor Crew card on 7/8 — different creator and beginner-level angle.

items.title: AI Can FINALLY Edit Videos For You
items.excerpt: A hands-on look at new AI video-editing agents that take over timeline editing work, and what that means for editors' workflows. Upload date verified via watch-page JSON-LD (2026-07-07T17:09:25-07:00).
items.why: Editing is the least-AI-covered craft in this section's recent run; strongest of the three social candidates for novelty.

items.title: How to 'Vibe Direct' Short Films
items.excerpt: A tutorial on conversational 'vibe directing' of short films with AI tools, following the wave started by OpenArt's dialogue-driven film generation. Upload date verified via watch-page JSON-LD (2026-07-07T06:01:10-07:00).
items.why: Practical follow-up to the OpenArt vibe-directing news card (7/6) — possible thematic overlap, use as alternate to the other two Matt Wolfe items.
